library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

catalogue_path <- "data/metadata/catalogue.csv"
activity_catalogue_path <- "data/metadata/catalogue_activites.csv"

html_escape <- function(value) {
  value <- as.character(value)
  value[is.na(value)] <- ""
  value <- str_replace_all(value, "&", "&amp;")
  value <- str_replace_all(value, "<", "&lt;")
  value <- str_replace_all(value, ">", "&gt;")
  value <- str_replace_all(value, '"', "&quot;")
  value <- str_replace_all(value, "'", "&#39;")
  value
}

clean_value <- function(value, fallback = "Je ne sais pas.") {
  value <- str_squish(as.character(value))
  if (length(value) == 0L || is.na(value) || value == "") {
    fallback
  } else {
    value
  }
}

split_concepts <- function(value) {
  values <- str_split(clean_value(value, ""), ";\\s*")[[1]]
  values[str_squish(values) != ""]
}

format_score <- function(value) {
  score <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value))
  if (is.na(score)) {
    list(label = "Je ne sais pas.", percent = 0, filled = 0)
  } else {
    percent <- max(0, min(100, round(score / 30 * 100)))
    filled <- max(0, min(5, ceiling(percent / 20)))
    list(label = paste0(score, "/30"), percent = percent, filled = filled)
  }
}

format_score_segments <- function(score) {
  paste(vapply(seq_len(5), function(i) {
    class <- if (i <= score$filled) "score-segment is-filled" else "score-segment"
    paste0('<span class="', class, '"></span>')
  }, character(1)), collapse = "")
}

list_tokens <- function(value) {
  tokens <- str_split(clean_value(value, ""), ",\\s*|;\\s*")[[1]]
  tokens <- str_squish(tokens)
  tokens[tokens != ""]
}

first_token <- function(value) {
  values <- split_concepts(value)
  if (length(values) == 0L) {
    ""
  } else {
    values[[1]]
  }
}

format_learning_focus <- function(row) {
  mini_project <- first_token(row$idees_mini_projets)
  if (mini_project != "") {
    return(str_trunc(mini_project, 118))
  }

  activity_question <- clean_value(row$activity_question, "")
  if (activity_question != "") {
    return(str_trunc(activity_question, 118))
  }

  concepts <- split_concepts(row$concepts)
  if (length(concepts) > 0L) {
    return(paste0("Travailler ", str_to_lower(paste(head(concepts, 2), collapse = " et ")), "."))
  }

  "Explorer la structure, les limites et les usages pédagogiques du jeu de données."
}

format_filter_group <- function(values, name, max_options = Inf, more_label = "Voir plus") {
  values <- str_squish(as.character(values))
  values <- values[!is.na(values) & values != ""]
  counts <- sort(table(values), decreasing = TRUE)
  has_more <- is.finite(max_options) && length(counts) > max_options

  options <- paste(vapply(seq_along(counts), function(i) {
    value <- names(counts)[i]
    input_id <- paste0(name, "-", i)
    hidden <- if (has_more && i > max_options) " is-extra" else ""
    paste0(
      '<label class="filter-option', hidden, '" for="', html_escape(input_id), '">',
      '<input id="', html_escape(input_id), '" type="checkbox" name="', html_escape(name), '" value="', html_escape(value), '">',
      '<span>', html_escape(value), '</span>',
      '<strong>', as.integer(counts[[i]]), '</strong>',
      '</label>'
    )
  }, character(1)), collapse = "\n")

  if (has_more) {
    options <- paste0(
      options,
      '\n<button class="filter-more" type="button" data-toggle-filter-group="',
      html_escape(name),
      '">',
      html_escape(more_label),
      "</button>"
    )
  }

  options
}

concept_family_definitions <- list(
  "Importer et nettoyer" = c(
    "importation", "nettoyage", "conversion", "valeurs manquantes",
    "qualité des données", "dictionnaire", "format long", "jointure",
    "clés", "codes", "coordonnées invalides"
  ),
  "Décrire et comparer" = c(
    "statistique descriptive", "comparaison", "groupes", "catégories",
    "tableaux de fréquences", "unités de mesure", "ratios", "médiane",
    "indicateurs"
  ),
  "Visualiser" = c(
    "visualisation", "graphique", "carte", "cartographie"
  ),
  "Modéliser" = c(
    "modélisation", "régression", "prédiction", "relations"
  ),
  "Éthique et limites" = c(
    "éthique", "limites", "biais", "communication prudente",
    "données sensibles", "risques", "communication du risque"
  ),
  "Données spatiales" = c(
    "spatial", "spatiale", "géolocalisation", "cartographie",
    "coordonnées", "territoire"
  ),
  "Séries temporelles" = c(
    "séries temporelles", "temporelle", "dates", "mensuelle", "annuelle"
  )
)

concept_families <- function(value) {
  concept_text <- str_to_lower(paste(split_concepts(value), collapse = " "))
  if (concept_text == "") {
    return(character())
  }

  families <- names(concept_family_definitions)[vapply(concept_family_definitions, function(patterns) {
    any(str_detect(concept_text, fixed(str_to_lower(patterns))))
  }, logical(1))]

  if (length(families) == 0L) {
    "Autres notions"
  } else {
    families
  }
}

format_chip <- function(label, attrs = "", active = FALSE) {
  class <- if (active) "filter-chip is-active" else "filter-chip"
  paste0('<button class="', class, '" type="button" ', attrs, '>', html_escape(label), "</button>")
}

  catalogue <- read_csv(catalogue_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  if (file.exists(activity_catalogue_path)) {
    activity_questions <- read_csv(activity_catalogue_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
      group_by(dataset_id) |>
      summarise(activity_question = first(question), .groups = "drop")

    catalogue <- catalogue |>
      left_join(activity_questions, by = c("id" = "dataset_id"))
  } else {
    catalogue$activity_question <- NA_character_
  }

  cat('<section class="catalogue-page page-full catalogue-reference" data-catalogue>\n')

  cat('<button class="catalogue-reset-link top-reset" type="button" data-reset-catalogue>Réinitialiser</button>\n')
  cat('</div>\n')
  cat('</div>\n')
  cat('</div>\n')
  cat('<section class="catalogue-intent-panel" aria-labelledby="catalogue-intent-title">\n')

  cat('<button class="catalogue-intent" type="button" data-intent-family="Décrire et comparer" aria-pressed="false"><span>Décrire et comparer</span><small>Tableaux, indicateurs et groupes</small></button>\n')

  cat('<script>\n')
  cat('(function () {\n')

  cat('  if (!root) return;\n')
  cat('  const searchInput = root.querySelector("#dataset-search");\n')
  cat('  const resetButtons = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll("[data-reset-catalogue]"));\n')
  cat('  const sortSelect = root.querySelector("#dataset-sort");\n')
  cat('  const countNode = root.querySelector("[data-result-count]");\n')
  cat('  const emptyNode = root.querySelector("[data-empty-catalogue]");\n')
  cat('  const grid = root.querySelector(".dataset-grid");\n')
  cat('  const cards = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(".dataset-card"));\n')
  cat('  const filterSidebar = root.querySelector(".catalogue-sidebar");\n')
  cat('  const mobileFiltersButton = root.querySelector("[data-toggle-mobile-filters]");\n')
  cat('  const mobileFiltersCloseButton = root.querySelector("[data-close-mobile-filters]");\n')
  cat('  const intentButtons = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll("[data-intent-family]"));\n')
  cat('  let activeLevelFragment = "";\n')
  cat('  const normalize = function (value) {\n')
  cat('    return (value || "").toString().toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g, "");\n')
  cat('  };\n')
  cat('  const pluralize = function (count) {\n')
  cat('    return count + " jeu" + (count > 1 ? "x" : "") + " de données";\n')
  cat('  };\n')
  cat('  const checked = function (name) {\n')
  cat('    return Array.from(root.querySelectorAll("input[name=\\"" + name + "\\"]:checked")).map(function (input) { return input.value; });\n')
  cat('  };\n')
  cat('  const matchesList = function (selected, value) {\n')
  cat('    return selected.length === 0 || selected.includes(value || "");\n')
  cat('  };\n')
  cat('  const matchesTokens = function (selected, value) {\n')
  cat('    if (selected.length === 0) return true;\n')
  cat('    const tokens = (value || "").split("||");\n')
  cat('    return selected.some(function (item) { return tokens.includes(item); });\n')
  cat('  };\n')
  cat('  const sortCards = function () {\n')
  cat('    const mode = sortSelect ? sortSelect.value : "relevance";\n')
  cat('    const sorted = cards.slice().sort(function (a, b) {\n')
  cat('      if (mode === "title") return (a.dataset.title || "").localeCompare(b.dataset.title || "", "fr");\n')
  cat('      if (mode === "score") return (Number(b.dataset.score) || 0) - (Number(a.dataset.score) || 0);\n')
  cat('      return cards.indexOf(a) - cards.indexOf(b);\n')
  cat('    });\n')
  cat('    sorted.forEach(function (card) { grid.appendChild(card); });\n')
  cat('  };\n')
  cat('  const update = function () {\n')
  cat('    const queryTokens = normalize(searchInput.value).split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);\n')
  cat('    const themes = checked("theme");\n')
  cat('    const levels = checked("level");\n')
  cat('    const concepts = checked("concept");\n')
  cat('    const conceptFamilies = checked("concept-family");\n')
  cat('    const licenses = checked("license");\n')
  cat('    let visible = 0;\n')
  cat('    cards.forEach(function (card) {\n')
  cat('      const searchableText = normalize(card.dataset.search);\n')
  cat('      const matchesQuery = queryTokens.length === 0 || queryTokens.every(function (token) { return searchableText.includes(token); });\n')
  cat('      const matchesTheme = matchesList(themes, card.dataset.theme);\n')
  cat('      const matchesLevel = matchesList(levels, card.dataset.level) && (!activeLevelFragment || normalize(card.dataset.level).includes(normalize(activeLevelFragment)));\n')
  cat('      const matchesConceptFamily = matchesTokens(conceptFamilies, card.dataset.conceptFamilies);\n')
  cat('      const matchesConcept = matchesTokens(concepts, card.dataset.concepts);\n')
  cat('      const matchesLicense = matchesList(licenses, card.dataset.license);\n')
  cat('      const show = matchesQuery && matchesTheme && matchesLevel && matchesConceptFamily && matchesConcept && matchesLicense;\n')
  cat('      card.hidden = !show;\n')
  cat('      if (show) visible += 1;\n')
  cat('    });\n')
  cat('    countNode.textContent = pluralize(visible);\n')
  cat('    emptyNode.hidden = visible !== 0;\n')
  cat('    root.querySelector("[data-clear-group=\\"theme\\"]")?.classList.toggle("is-active", themes.length === 0);\n')
  cat('    root.querySelector("[data-clear-group=\\"level\\"]")?.classList.toggle("is-active", levels.length === 0 && !activeLevelFragment);\n')
  cat('    root.querySelectorAll("[data-level-fragment]").forEach(function (button) {\n')
  cat('      button.classList.toggle("is-active", button.dataset.levelFragment === activeLevelFragment);\n')
  cat('    });\n')
  cat('    intentButtons.forEach(function (button) {\n')
  cat('      const isActive = conceptFamilies.length === 1 && conceptFamilies[0] === button.dataset.intentFamily;\n')
  cat('      button.classList.toggle("is-active", isActive);\n')
  cat('      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(isActive));\n')
  cat('    });\n')
  cat('  };\n')
  cat('  const revealResults = function () {\n')
  cat('    root.querySelector(".catalogue-results")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });\n')
  cat('  };\n')
  cat('  searchInput.addEventListener("input", update);\n')
  cat('  if (sortSelect) sortSelect.addEventListener("change", function () { sortCards(); update(); });\n')
  cat('  root.querySelectorAll(".catalogue-sidebar input").forEach(function (input) {\n')
  cat('    input.addEventListener("change", update);\n')
  cat('  });\n')
  cat('  root.querySelectorAll("[data-clear-group]").forEach(function (button) {\n')
  cat('    button.addEventListener("click", function () {\n')
  cat('      const name = button.dataset.clearGroup;\n')
  cat('      root.querySelectorAll("input[name=\\"" + name + "\\"]").forEach(function (input) { input.checked = false; });\n')
  cat('      if (name === "level") activeLevelFragment = "";\n')
  cat('      update();\n')
  cat('      revealResults();\n')
  cat('    });\n')
  cat('  });\n')
  cat('  root.querySelectorAll("[data-level-fragment]").forEach(function (button) {\n')
  cat('    button.addEventListener("click", function () {\n')
  cat('      activeLevelFragment = activeLevelFragment === button.dataset.levelFragment ? "" : button.dataset.levelFragment;\n')
  cat('      root.querySelectorAll("input[name=\\"level\\"]").forEach(function (input) { input.checked = false; });\n')
  cat('      update();\n')
  cat('      revealResults();\n')
  cat('    });\n')
  cat('  });\n')
  cat('  intentButtons.forEach(function (button) {\n')
  cat('    button.addEventListener("click", function () {\n')
  cat('      root.querySelectorAll("input[name=\\"concept-family\\"]").forEach(function (input) { input.checked = input.value === button.dataset.intentFamily; });\n')
  cat('      root.querySelectorAll("input[name=\\"concept\\"]").forEach(function (input) { input.checked = false; });\n')
  cat('      searchInput.value = "";\n')
  cat('      activeLevelFragment = "";\n')
  cat('      update();\n')
  cat('      revealResults();\n')
  cat('    });\n')
  cat('  });\n')
  cat('  root.querySelectorAll("[data-toggle-filter-group]").forEach(function (button) {\n')
  cat('    button.addEventListener("click", function () {\n')
  cat('      const group = button.closest(".filter-group");\n')
  cat('      group.classList.toggle("is-expanded");\n')
  cat('      button.textContent = group.classList.contains("is-expanded") ? "Voir moins" : "Voir plus";\n')
  cat('    });\n')
  cat('  });\n')
  cat('  const setMobileFiltersOpen = function (open, returnFocus) {\n')
  cat('    if (!filterSidebar || !mobileFiltersButton) return;\n')
  cat('    filterSidebar.classList.toggle("is-mobile-open", open);\n')
  cat('    mobileFiltersButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));\n')
  cat('    if (open) {\n')
  cat('      filterSidebar.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });\n')
  cat('      window.setTimeout(function () { filterSidebar.querySelector("input, button")?.focus(); }, 250);\n')
  cat('    } else if (returnFocus) {\n')
  cat('      mobileFiltersButton.focus();\n')
  cat('    }\n')
  cat('  };\n')
  cat('  mobileFiltersButton?.addEventListener("click", function () {\n')
  cat('    if (window.matchMedia("(max-width: 900px)").matches) {\n')
  cat('      setMobileFiltersOpen(!filterSidebar.classList.contains("is-mobile-open"), false);\n')
  cat('    } else {\n')
  cat('      filterSidebar?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });\n')
  cat('    }\n')
  cat('  });\n')
  cat('  mobileFiltersCloseButton?.addEventListener("click", function () { setMobileFiltersOpen(false, true); });\n')
  cat('  window.addEventListener("resize", function () {\n')
  cat('    if (!window.matchMedia("(max-width: 900px)").matches) setMobileFiltersOpen(false, false);\n')
  cat('  });\n')
  cat('  resetButtons.forEach(function (button) {\n')
  cat('    button.addEventListener("click", function () {\n')
  cat('      searchInput.value = "";\n')
  cat('      root.querySelectorAll(".catalogue-sidebar input").forEach(function (input) { input.checked = false; });\n')
  cat('      activeLevelFragment = "";\n')
  cat('      if (sortSelect) sortSelect.value = "relevance";\n')
  cat('      sortCards();\n')
  cat('      update();\n')
  cat('      searchInput.focus();\n')
  cat('    });\n')
  cat('  });\n')
  cat('  sortCards();\n')
  cat('  update();\n')
  cat('})();\n')
  cat('</script>\n')
} else {
  cat("Le catalogue n'a pas encore été généré. Exécuter `Rscript scripts/build_catalogue.R`.")
}
